description: This PHP class 'MigrationHelper' manages database migration logging, including starting and finishing migration records, creating migration log table if needed, and interacting with Doctrine DBAL for database operations.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing database migration logs, including starting and finishing migration entries, and creating the migration log table if it does not exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes MigrationHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns the SchemaHelper instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: logMigrationStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a migration, creating the migration log table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: logMigrationFinished
methods.description: Marks a migration as finished by updating the 'finished_at' timestamp for the latest record of the given version.
